verdict.rationale: macOS Setup Assistant documents the story's core: bringing an iPhone near a new Mac signs the user in to Wi-Fi and their Apple Account. Migration Assistant separately supports quick setup, including for people moving from Windows. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the proximity setup flow (what else it configures beyond Wi-Fi and Apple Account), independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can set up a new machine quickly by bringing a paired personal device near it

citations.quote: Just bring your iPhone near your Mac, and Setup Assistant signs you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account.
With Migration Assistant, setting up a new Mac is still quick and easy — even if you’re migrating from Windows.
